stem: The heights of plants of type $A$ have mean 1.2 m and standard deviation 0.03 m. A random sample of 5 plants of type $A$ is selected. The sum of the heights of these 5 plants is denoted by $H_A$ m.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of $H_A$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: The heights of plants of type $B$ have mean 0.6 m and standard deviation 0.02 m. A random sample of 5 plants of type $B$ is selected. The sum of the heights of these 5 plants is denoted by $H_B$ m.
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of $H_A - 2H_B$.
